comment: R10 marquee alias table (E1). A bare family name either maps to its canonical primary (alternatives ride as candidates) or forces a curated disambiguation — marquee families never bind silently. Every symbol is verified against the NSE master at test time. TMCV replaces the delisted TATAMOTORS (2025 demerger; the passenger-vehicle sibling TMPV is also NSE-listed but the curated list carries one Tata Motors entry).
